structuredContent.answer: Per-source comparison values are not all current: Epic Cosmos (ED visits) last reported week ending 2026-09-26 — 14 days behind the map date. Overall RSV activity across states is minimal (median 1.8% of the 2-year peak). RSV by % of ED visits, highest 3 of 48 states and DC (CDC NSSP (ED visits), week ending 2026-10-10). CDC NSSP (ED visits) is 1 of 8 PopHIVE RSV signals; others: CDC NHSN (hospitalizations), CDC NWSS (wastewater), CDC RespNET (hospitalizations), +4 more. Highest: Hawaii at 0.25% of ED visits. 2 of 4 other sources rank Hawaii in their top 10. 1 more signals not shown (CDC NHSN); request one by name for its full ranking. Median across all states: 0.02% of ED visits; IQR 0.01–0.05. The most recent 2 weeks are preliminary and may be revised.
caveats: Preliminary: NSSP and NHSN values for the most recent 2 weeks are subject to upward revision.

NWSS wastewater viral activity is scaled standard deviations above a dynamic baseline, population-weighted to state/national; CDC's Aug 2025 methodology update applies retroactively to all history; updated Fridays.
Epic Cosmos (de-identified EHR, ~300M patients, 1,600+ hospitals): counts <10 are suppressed and imputed at half the minimum; treat low values as 'low,' not as a measurement.
3 states report exactly 0.0 — for detection-style measures this can mean not reporting, not zero activity.
